points.description: Gives the correct final answer of $2 per pack of strawberry gum, supported by a fully valid calculation (e.g. grape gum costs $2, green apple gum costs $1, so the two strawberry packs total $4).

rubric.notes: Full marks require the correct final answer with every step mathematically valid. A wrong final answer or any invalid step earns no marks. There is no partial credit.
